BW-BENCH-EQ70-30.name: 70/30 US Large/Small all-equity blend (70% IWB + 30% IWM)
BW-BENCH-EQ70-30.methodology: Fixed-weight all-equity blend: 70% iShares Russell 1000 ETF (IWB) + 30% iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM). Each component's in-ERM3 weight vector is renormalized to 1, scaled by its notional weight, and the two are summed over the union of symbols at each teo the components share. Illustrative large/small split (IWB ∪ IWM ≈ Russell 3000).
BW-BENCH-EQ70-30.rebalance_schedule: Notional weights fixed at 70/30; the component weight vectors drift with the underlying ETF holdings (no rebalancing of the blend itself in v1).

BW-BENCH-SPY.name: S&P 500 (proxy: iShares Core S&P 500 ETF, IVV)
BW-BENCH-SPY.methodology: Float-adjusted market-cap-weighted S&P 500 constituents, proxied by iShares Core S&P 500 ETF (IVV)'s published daily holdings. The benchmark surface = IVV's in-ERM3 holdings renormalized to weights summing to 1 (cash / non-ERM3 lines dropped, as for any portfolio surface).
BW-BENCH-SPY.rebalance_schedule: S&P 500 reconstitution is quarterly (effective the 3rd Friday of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec) plus ad-hoc index changes; the surface tracks IVV's daily-published holdings, so per-teo weights move with IVV (which itself tracks the index ~daily).
BW-BENCH-SPY.notes: v1 proxies the index via IVV; a direct S&P-constituent feed would be a follow-on.
